raw.rationale: Broad-spectrum HDAC inhibitors like this one typically show only modest lineage selectivity in PRISM screens, with the strongest recurrent sensitivities in hematologic lineages (not listed) and occasional enrichment in lung, breast, and colorectal lines; at 2.5 µM for 5 days, pan-HDAC inhibition causes widespread cytotoxicity, lowering the chance of lineage-specific effects. Published PRISM/CTRP data for HDAC inhibitors indicate low single-digit percent base rates per lineage, so probabilities are kept near the 0.2–2.5% baseline with slight adjustments for known lineage dependencies.
